title: Positive-degree quasi-isomorphism of the free module hypercover augmentation
statement: let e be the displayed free R-module augmented alternating-face morphism; for every i > 0, QuasiIsoAt e i

proof.text: The positive-degree matching and coskeleton contraction is coefficientwise over R. The matching-object/coskeleton identification and coskeleton free-homology comparison propagate the contraction to every positive degree, then sheafification identifies it with e.

lean.statement:
theorem hypercover_freeModule_quasiIsoAt_pos
    {X : Scheme.{w}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : SplitEtaleHypercover X) (R : Type (w + 1)) [CommRing R] :
    let e := (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε.app
      ((SimplicialObject.Augmented.whiskeringObj X.Etale _
        (uliftYoneda.{w + 1} ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight X.Etaleᵒᵖ (Type (w + 1)) (ModuleCat.{w + 1} R)).obj
            (ModuleCat.free R) ⋙
          presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{w + 1} R))).obj
        (U.simplicial.augmentOfIsTerminal (terminalIsTerminal (C := X.Etale)))));
    ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → QuasiIsoAt e i
